note: Imam al-Būṣīrī's second famous ode in praise of the Prophet ﷺ, distinct from the Burdah.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ صَلِّ عَلَى الْمُخْتَارِ مِنْ مُضَرٍ ۞ وَالْأَنْبِيَا وَجَمِيعِ الرُّسْلِ مَا ذُكِرُوا
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi ṣalli ʿalā l-mukhtāri min Muḍarin, wa-l-anbiyā wa-jamiʿi r-rusli mā dhukirū.
verses.en: O my Lord, send prayers upon the Chosen One from Mudar, and upon the Prophets and all the Messengers whenever they are mentioned.

verses.ar: وَصَلِّ رَبِّ عَلَى الْهَادِي وَشِيعَتِهِ ۞ وَصَحْبِهِ مَنْ لِطَيِّ الدِّينِ قَدْ نَشَرُوا
verses.tr: Wa-ṣalli Rabbi ʿalā l-hādī wa-shīʿatihi, wa-ṣaḥbihi man liṭayyi d-dīni qad nasharū.
verses.en: And send prayers, O my Lord, upon the Guide, his followers, and his Companions, who spread the teachings of the religion.

verses.ar: وَجَاهَدُوا مَعَهُ فِي اللَّهِ وَاجْتَهَدُوا ۞ وَهَاجَرُوا وَلَهُ آوَوْا وَقَدْ نَصَرُوا
verses.tr: Wa-jāhadū maʿahu fī Llāhi wa-jtahadū, wa-hājarū wa-lahu āwaw wa-qad naṣarū.
verses.en: Who strove alongside him in the path of Allah with tireless resolve, who emigrated, gave him refuge, and came to his aid.

verses.ar: وَبَيَّنُوا الْفَرْضَ وَالْمَسْنُونَ وَاعْتَصَبُوا ۞ لِلَّهِ وَاعْتَصَمُوا بِاللَّهِ فَانْتَصَرُوا
verses.tr: Wa-bayyanū l-farḍa wa-l-masnūna wa-ʿtaṣabū, li-Llāhi wa-ʿtaṣamū bi-Llāhi fa-ntaṣarū.
verses.en: Who made clear what is obligatory and what is from the Sunnah, dedicated themselves wholly to Allah, held fast to Allah, and so were granted victory.

verses.ar: أَزْكَى صَلَاةٍ وَأَنْمَاهَا وَأَشْرَفَهَا ۞ يُعَطِّرُ الْكَوْنَ رَيَّا نَشْرِهَا الْعَطِرُ
verses.tr: Azkā ṣalātin wa-anmāhā wa-ashrafahā, yuʿaṭṭiru l-kawna rayyā nashrihā l-ʿaṭiru.
verses.en: The purest, most abundant, and most exalted of prayers, whose fragrant scent fills the whole universe.

verses.ar: مَعْبُوقَةً بِعَبِيقِ الْمِسْكِ زَاكِيَةً ۞ مِنْ طِيبِهَا أَرَجُ الرِّضْوَانِ يَنْتَشِرُ
verses.tr: Maʿbūqatan bi-ʿabīqi l-miski zākiyatan, min ṭībihā araju r-riḍwāni yantashiru.
verses.en: Perfumed with the rich fragrance of musk, pure and delightful, from whose fragrance the perfume of Allah's good pleasure spreads.

verses.ar: عَدَّ الْحَصَى وَالثَّرَى وَالرَّمْلِ يَتْبَعُهَا ۞ نَجْمُ السَّمَا وَنَبَاتُ الْأَرْضِ وَالْمَدَرُ
verses.tr: ʿAdda l-haṣā wa-th-tharā wa-r-ramli yatbaʿuhā, najmu s-samā wa-nabātu l-arḍi wa-l-madaru.
verses.en: As numerous as the pebbles, the fertile earth, and every grain of sand, and as the stars of the heavens, the plants of the earth, and every clod of clay.

verses.ar: وَعَدَّ وَزْنِ مَثَاقِيلِ الْجِبَالِ كَمَا ۞ يَلِيهِ قَطْرُ جَمِيعِ الْمَاءِ وَالْمَطَرُ
verses.tr: Wa-ʿadda wazni mathāqīli l-jibāli kamā, yalīhi qaṭru jamiʿi l-mā'i wa-l-maṭaru.
verses.en: As countless as the weight of every mountain, and every drop of water and rain that follows it.

verses.ar: وَعَدَّ مَا حَوَتِ الْأَشْجَارُ مِنْ وَرَقٍ ۞ وَكُلِّ حَرْفٍ غَدَا يُتْلَى وَيُسْتَطَرُ
verses.tr: Wa-ʿadda mā ḥawati l-ashjāru min waraqin, wa-kulli ḥarfin ghadā yutlā wa-yustaṭaru.
verses.en: As numerous as every leaf borne upon the trees, and every letter that is recited and committed to writing.

verses.ar: وَالْوَحْشِ وَالطَّيْرِ وَالْأَسْمَاكِ مَعْ نَعَمٍ ۞ يَلِيهِمُ الْجِنُّ وَالْأَمْلَاكُ وَالْبَشَرُ
verses.tr: Wa-l-waḥshi wa-ṭ-ṭayri wa-l-asmāki maʿ naʿamin, yalīhimu l-jinnu wa-l-amlāku wa-l-basharu.
verses.en: As the wild beasts, the birds, the fish, and the grazing animals, and beyond them the jinn, the angels, and mankind.

verses.ar: وَالذَّرُّ وَالنَّمْلُ مَعْ جَمْعِ الْحُبُوبِ كَذَا ۞ وَالشَّعْرُ وَالصُّوفُ وَالْأَرْيَاشُ وَالْوَبَرُ
verses.tr: Wa-dh-dharru wa-n-namlu maʿ jamʿi l-ḥubūbi kadhā, wa-sh-shaʿru wa-ṣ-ṣūfu wa-l-aryāshu wa-l-wabaru.
verses.en: As the tiny creatures, the ants, and every gathered grain, and every hair, every fleece, every feather, and every strand of fur.

verses.ar: وَمَا أَحَاطَ بِهِ الْعِلْمُ الْمُحِيطُ وَمَا ۞ جَرَى بِهِ الْقَلَمُ الْمَأْمُورُ وَالْقَدَرُ
verses.tr: Wa-mā ahāṭa bihi l-ʿilmu l-muḥīṭu wa-mā, jarā bihi l-qalamu l-ma'mūru wa-l-qadaru.
verses.en: As all that is encompassed by Allah's all-embracing knowledge, and all that has been written by the commanded Pen and decreed by destiny.

verses.ar: وَعَدَّ نَعْمَائِكَ اللَّاتِي مَنَنْتَ بِهَا ۞ عَلَى الْخَلَائِقِ مُذْ كَانُوا وَمُذْ حُشِرُوا
verses.tr: Wa-ʿadda naʿmāika llātī mananta bihā, ʿalā l-khalā'iqi mudh kānū wa-mudh ḥushirū.
verses.en: As numerous as the favours You have bestowed upon creation, from the moment they came into being until they are gathered for judgement.

verses.ar: وَعَدَّ مِقْدَارِهِ السَّامِي الَّذِي شَرُفَتْ ۞ بِهِ النَّبِيُّونَ وَالْأَمْلَاكُ وَافْتَخَرُوا
verses.tr: Wa-ʿadda miqdārihi s-sāmī lladhī sharufat, bihi n-nabiyyūna wa-l-amlāku wa-ftakharū
verses.en: As countless as his exalted rank, through which the Prophets and the angels have been honoured and take pride.

verses.ar: وَعَدَّ مَا كَانَ فِي الْأَكْوَانِ يَا سَنَدِي ۞ وَمَا يَكُونُ إِلَى أَنْ تُبْعَثَ الصُّوَرُ
verses.tr: Wa-ʿadda mā kāna fī l-akwāni yā sanadī, wa-mā yakūnu ilā an tubʿatha ṣ-ṣuwaru.
verses.en: As countless as all that has existed throughout creation, O my support, and all that shall exist until the Trumpets are blown.

verses.ar: فِي كُلِّ طَرْفَةِ عَيْنٍ يَطْرِفُونَ بِهَا ۞ أَهْلُ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِينَ أَوْ يَذَرُوا
verses.tr: Fī kulli ṭarfati ʿaynin yaṭrifūna bihā, ahlu s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍīna aw yadharū.
verses.en: With every blink of an eye made by the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth, or every moment in which they refrain from blinking.

verses.ar: مِلْءَ السَّمَاوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِينَ مَعْ جَبَلٍ ۞ وَالْفَرْشِ وَالْعَرْشِ وَالْكُرْسِي وَمَا حَصَرُوا
verses.tr: Mil'a s-samāwāti wa-l-arḍīna maʿ jabalin, wa-l-farshi wa-l-ʿarshi wa-l-kursī wa-mā ḥaṣarū.
verses.en: Enough to fill the heavens and the earth, the mountains, the earth, the Throne, the Footstool, and all that lies beyond enumeration.

verses.ar: مَا أَعْدَمَ اللَّهُ مَوْجُودًا وَأَوْجَدَ مَعْدُومًا صَلَاةً دَوَامًا لَيْسَ تَنْحَصِرُ
verses.tr: Mā aʿdama Llāhu mawjūdan wa-awjada maʿdūman ṣalātan dawāman laysa tanḥaṣiru.
verses.en: As countless as every being Allah has caused to pass away, and every non-existent thing He has brought into existence, prayers without end.

verses.ar: تَسْتَغْرِقُ الْعَدَّ مَعْ جَمْعِ الدُّهُورِ كَمَا ۞ تُحِيطُ بِالْحَدِّ لَا تُبْقِي وَلَا تَذَرُ
verses.tr: Tastaghriqu l-ʿadda maʿ jamʿi d-duhūri kamā, tuḥīṭu bi-l- ḥaddi la tubqī wa-lā tadharu.
verses.en: Prayers that surpass every reckoning throughout all ages, embracing every limit, leaving nothing behind.

verses.ar: لَا غَايَةً وَانْتِهَاءً يَا عَظِيمُ لَهَا ۞ وَلَا لَهَا أَمَدٌ يُقْضَى فَيُعْتَبَرُ
verses.tr: Lā ghāyatan wa-ntihā'an yā ʿaẓīmu lahā, wa-lā lahā amadun yuqḍā fa-yuʿtabaru.
verses.en: They have neither end nor limit, how magnificent they are! No appointed term can ever bring them to a close.

verses.ar: وَعَدَّ أَضْعَافِ مَا قَدْ مَرَّ مِنْ عَدَدٍ ۞ مَعْ ضِعْفِ أَضْعَافِهِ يَا مَنْ لَهُ الْقَدَرُ
verses.tr: Wa-ʿadda aḍʿāfi mā qad marra min ʿadadin, maʿ ḍiʿfi aḍʿāfihi yā man lahu l-qadaru.
verses.en: Multiplied beyond every number already mentioned, and multiplied again beyond measure, O Possessor of all power.

verses.ar: كَمَا تُحِبُّ وَتَرْضَى سَيِّدِي وَكَمَا ۞ أَمَرْتَنَا أَنْ نُصَلِّي أَنْتَ مُقْتَدِرُ
verses.tr: Kamā tuḥibbu wa-tarḍā sayyidī wa-kamā, amartanā an nuṣallī anta muqtadiru.
verses.en: As You love and are pleased with, my Lord, and as You have commanded us to send prayers, for You have power over all things.

verses.ar: مَعَ السَّلَامِ كَمَا قَدْ مَرَّ مِنْ عَدَدٍ ۞ رَبِّي وَضَاعِفْهُمَا وَالْفَضْلُ مُنْتَشِرُ
verses.tr: Maʿa s-salāmi kamā qad marra min ʿadadin, Rabbī wa-ḍāʿifhumā wa-l-faḍlu muntashiru.
verses.en: Together with peace, in the same immeasurable number already mentioned. My Lord, multiply them both, for Your bounty knows no bounds.

verses.ar: وَكُلُّ ذَلِكَ مَضْرُوبٌ بِحَقِّكَ فِي ۞ أَنْفَاسِ خَلْقِكَ إِنْ قَلُّوا وَإِنْ كَثُرُوا
verses.tr: Wa-kullu dhālika maḍrūbun bi-ḥaqqika fī anfāsi khalqika in qallū wa-in kathurū.
verses.en: And let all of that be multiplied, by Your truth, with every breath taken by Your creation, whether few or many.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ وَاغْفِرْ لِقَارِيهَا وَسَامِعِهَا ۞ وَالْمُسْلِمِينَ جَمِيعًا أَيْنَمَا حَضَرُوا
verses.tr: Ya Rabbī wa-ghfir li-qārīhā wa-sāmiʿihā, wa-l-muslimīna jamīʿan aynamā ḥaḍarū.
verses.en: O my Lord, forgive the one who recites it and the one who listens to it, and all the Muslims, wherever they may be.

verses.ar: وَوَالِدِينَا وَأَهْلِينَا وَجِيرَتِنَا ۞ وَكُلُّنَا سَيِّدِي لِلْعَفْوِ مُفْتَقِرُ
verses.tr: Wa-wālidīnā wa-ahlīnā wa-jīratinā, wa-kullunā sayyidī li-l-ʿafwi muftaqiru.
verses.en: And our parents, our families, and our neighbours, for all of us, my Lord, stand in need of Your forgiveness.

verses.ar: وَقَدْ أَتَيْتُ ذُنُوبًا لَا عِدَادَ لَهَا ۞ لَكِنَّ عَفْوَكَ لَا يُبْقِي وَلَا يَذَرُ
verses.tr: Wa-qad ataytu dhunūban lā ʿidāda lahā, Lākinna ʿafwaka lā yubqī wa-lā yadharu.
verses.en: I have committed sins beyond all reckoning, yet Your pardon leaves none of them behind.

verses.ar: وَالْهَمُّ عَنْ كُلِّ مَا أَبْغِيهِ أَشْغَلَنِي ۞ وَقَدْ أَتَى خَاضِعًا وَالْقَلْبُ مُنْكَسِرُ
verses.tr: Wa-l-hammu ʿan kulli mā abghīhi ashghalanī, wa-qad atā khāḍiʿan wa-l-qalbu munkasiru.
verses.en: My worries have consumed me and distracted me from all that I seek, yet I have come before You in humility, with a broken heart.

verses.ar: أَرْجُوكَ يَا رَبِّ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ تَرْحَمُنَا ۞ بِجَاهِ مَنْ فِي يَدَيْهِ سَبَّحَ الْحَجَرُ
verses.tr: Arjūka yā Rabbī fī d-darayni tarḥamunā, bi-jāhi man fī yadayhi sabbaḥa l-ḥajaru.
verses.en: I implore You, O my Lord, to have mercy upon us in this world and the Hereafter, through the honour of the one in whose hands the stones glorified You.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ أَعْظِمْ لَنَا أَجْرًا وَمَغْفِرَةً ۞ فَإِنَّ جُودَكَ بَحْرٌ لَيْسَ يَنْحَصِرُ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbī aʿẓim lanā ajran wa-maghfiratan, fa-inna jūdaka baḥrun laysa yanḥaṣiru.
verses.en: O my Lord, grant us an immense reward and abundant forgiveness, for Your generosity is an ocean without shore or end.

verses.ar: وَاقْضِ دُيُونًا لَهَا الْأَخْلَاقُ ضَائِقَةٌ ۞ وَفَرِّجِ الْكَرْبَ عَنَّا أَنْتَ مَقْتَدِرُ
verses.tr: Wa-qḍi duyūnan lahā l-akhlāqu ḍā'iqatun, wa-farriji l-karba ʿannā anta muqtadiru.
verses.en: Relieve us of debts that weigh heavily upon us, and remove our distress, for You have power over all things.

verses.ar: وَكُنْ لَطِيفًا بِنَا فِي كُلِّ نَازِلَةٍ ۞ لُطْفًا جَمِيلًا بِهِ الْأَهْوَالُ تَنْحَسِرُ
verses.tr: Wa-kun laṭīfan binā fī kulli nāzilatin, luṭfan jamīlan bihi l-ahwālu tanḥasiru.
verses.en: Show us Your gentle care in every trial, with a beautiful kindness by which every hardship is lifted.

verses.ar: بِالْمُصْطَفَى الْمُجْتَبَى خَيْرِ الْأَنَامِ وَمَنْ ۞ جَلَالَةً نَزَلَتْ فِي مَدْحِهِ السُّوَرُ
verses.tr: Bi-l-Muṣṭafā l-mujtabā khayri l-anāmi wa-man, jalālatan nazalat fī madḥihi s-suwaru.
verses.en: Through the Chosen One, the Elect, the best of all creation, whose praise is proclaimed by the majestic chapters of the Quran.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ الصَّلَاةُ عَلَى الْمُخْتَارِ مَا طَلَعَتْ ۞ شَمْسُ النَّهَارِ وَمَا قَدْ شَعْشَعَ الْقَمَرُ
verses.tr: Thumma ṣ-ṣalatu ʿalā l-mukhtāri mā ṭalaʿat, shamsu n-nahāri wa-mā qad shaʿshaʿa l-qamaru.
verses.en: Then send prayers upon the Chosen One for as long as the sun rises by day, and for as long as the moon shines with its radiant light.

verses.ar: ثُمَّ الرِّضَا عَنْ أَبِي بَكْرٍ خَلِيفَتِهِ ۞ مَنْ قَامَ مِنْ بَعْدِهِِ لِلدِّينِ يَنْتَصِرُ
verses.tr: Thumma r-riḍā ʿan Abī Bakrin khalīfatihi, man qāma min baʿdihi li-d-dīni yantaṣiru.
verses.en: Then may Allah be pleased with Abu Bakr, his successor, who upheld and defended the religion after him.

verses.ar: وَعَنْ أَبِي حَفْصٍ الْفَارُوقِ صَاحِبِهِ ۞ مَنْ قَوْلُهُ الْفَصْلُ فِي أَحْكَامِهِ عُمَرُ
verses.tr: Wa-ʿan Abī Ḥafṣin l-Fārūqi ṣāḥibihi, man qawluhu l-faṣlu fī aḥkāmihi ʿUmaru.
verses.en: And with Abu Hafs al-Faruq, his noble Companion, Umar, whose judgement was decisive in matters of justice.

verses.ar: وَجُدْ لِعُثْمَانَ ذِي النُّورَيْنِ مَنْ كَمُلَتْ ۞ لَهُ الْمَحَاسِنُ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ وَالظَّفَرُ
verses.tr: Wa-jud li-ʿUthmāna dhī n-nūrayni man kamulat, Lahu l-maḥāsinu fī d-dārayni wa-ẓ-ẓafaru.
verses.en: And bestow Your grace upon Uthman, the Possessor of the Two Lights, whose noble virtues were perfected in this world and the Hereafter.

verses.ar: كَذَا عَلِيٌ مَعَ ابْنَيْهِ وَأُمِّهِمَا ۞ أَهْلُ الْعَبَاءِ كَمَا قَدْ جَاءَنَا الْخَبَرُ
verses.tr: Kadhā ʿAliyyun maʿa bnayhi wa-ummihimā, ahlu l-ʿabā'i kamā qad jā'ana l-khabaru.
verses.en: Likewise Ali, together with his two sons and their mother, the People of the Cloak, as authentically reported.

verses.ar: كَذَا خَدِيجَتُنَا الْكُبْرَى الَّتِي بَذَلَتْ ۞ أَمْوَالَهَا لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ يَنْتَصِرُ
verses.tr: Kadhā Khadījatunā l-Kubrā llatī badhalat, amwālahā li-rasūli Llāhi yantaṣiru.
verses.en: Likewise Khadijah al-Kubra, who devoted her wealth to the Messenger of Allah in support of his mission.

verses.ar: وَالطَّاهِرَاتُ نِسَاءُ الْمُصْطَفَى وَكَذَا ۞ بَنَاتُهُ وَبَنُوهُ كُلَّمَا ذُكِرُوا
verses.tr: Wa-ṭ-ṭāhirātu nisā'u l-Muṣṭafā wa-kadhā, banātuhu wa-banūhu kullamā dhukirū.
verses.en: And the pure wives of the Chosen One, together with his daughters and sons, whenever they are mentioned.

verses.ar: سَعْدٌ سَعِيدُ بْنُ عَوْفٍ طَلْحَةٌ وَأَبُو ۞ عُبَيْدَةٍ وَزُبَيْرٌ سَادَةٌ غُرَرُ
verses.tr: Saʿdun, Saʿīdu-bnu ʿAwfin, Ṭalḥatun wa-Abū ʿUbaydatin wa-Zubayrun sādatun ghuraru.
verses.en: Sa'd, Sa'id ibn Awf, Talhah, Abu Ubaydah, and al-Zubayr, illustrious leaders, radiant in virtue.

verses.ar: وَحَمْزَةٌ وَكَذَا الْعَبَّاسُ سَيِّدُنَا ۞ وَنَجْلُهُ الْحَبْرُ مَنْ زَالَتْ بِهِ الْغِيَرُ
verses.tr: Wa-Ḥamzatun wa-kadha l-ʿAbbāsu sayyidunā, wa-najluhu l-ḥabru man zālat bihi l-ghiyaru.
verses.en: Likewise Hamzah, and our master al-Abbas, and his son, the great scholar, through whom falsehood was dispelled.

verses.ar: وَالْآلُ وَالصَّحْبُ وَالْأَتْبَاعُ قَاطِبَةً ۞ مَا جَنَّ لَيْلُ الدَّيَاجِي أَوْ بَدَا السَّحَرُ
verses.tr: Wa-l-ālu wa-ṣ-ṣaḥbu wa-l-atbāʿu qāṭibatan, mā janna laylu d-dayājī aw badā s-saḥaru.
verses.en: And upon his Family, his Companions, and all who follow them, for as long as the darkness of night falls and the dawn appears.

verses.ar: مَعَ الرِّضَا مِنْكَ فِي عَفْوٍ وَعَافِيَةٍ ۞ وَحُسْنِ خَاتِمَةٍ إِنْ يَنْقَضِي الْعُمُرُ
verses.tr: Maʿa r-riḍā minka fī ʿafwin wa-ʿāfiyatin, wa-ḥusni khātimatin in yanqaḍi l-ʿumuru.
verses.en: Together with Your good pleasure, pardon, well-being, and a blessed ending when our lives draw to a close.
